Let me verify against the Makefile.

Use `make test-fast` to run the unit suite. It runs `pytest -m "not postgres" -q`, so it skips the Postgres tests.

To run everything, use `make test`, which runs `pytest -q`. A project memory says the Postgres tests need the database running first, so start it with `docker compose up db`. The Makefile doesn't mention docker, so I haven't confirmed that part.
